newsitem.title: USA: NYT expands national distribution - NYT.
newsitem.headline: NYT expands national distribution - NYT.

text.p: The New York Times reported on Wednesday that it was planning changes to make editions available around the country and to include later-breaking news and sports.
The newspaper also said it was introducing business pages in its Metro section that would appear Tuesday through Friday.

The Times said it has contracted with 33 daily newspapers to deliver its national edition. It said a similar deal with a national magazine distributor would raise the number of retail outlets offering the newspaper from 17,000 to more than 25,000.
